title: Grilled Lamb Kebabs with Mediterranean Flair
description: A classic German-inspired dish featuring marinated lamb kebabs with a mediterranean twist. Perfect for a summer BBQ.

ingredients.name: nutty
ingredients.notes: olive oil with a hint of nutmeg

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together nutty olive oil, crisp red onion, and mediterranean herb and garlic marinade.
3. Add lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Thread lamb cubes onto kebabs, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
6. Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
7. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
8. Enjoy with your favorite side dishes, such as roasted potatoes or a green salad.
